name: Effortless Armor
body:
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 228
School transmutation; Level cleric 2, hunter 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, occultist 2, oracle 2, paladin 2, psychic 2, ranger 2, warpriest 2
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute/level
Description
Armor you wear no longer reduces your speed. You also reduce the armor’s armor check penalty by 1 + 1 per five caster levels (maximum 5).
